subject: Manager delegation & routing for the annual feedback window
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Manager delegation & routing for the annual feedback window

Hi Laura + Logan --

As we close in on the annual feedback cycle I want to lock down two adjacent pieces we keep getting questions about from managers: (1) reviewer delegation (who steps in to write feedback if the primary manager is out) and (2) routing/escalation for sensitive cases (comp discussions, performance improvement actions).

Attached are two starter artifacts: a delegation matrix (manager-delegation-matrix_v1.xlsx) with proposed fallback owners and a small zip of notice templates (notice-templates_v1.zip) for managers to use when delegating or notifying employees. Ask: please review and send edits by EOD Friday (Aug 6) so we can publish the final manager pack on Monday Aug 9.

Key decisions we need to finalize this week:
- Delegation policy: are managers allowed to name peer reviewers inside other teams? (proposed: allowed with L2 manager sign-off)
- Sensitive flag: add a column in the matrix for 'sensitive_roles' to force HR review before delegation
- Escalation lane: if a delegated reviewer raises a grievance, where should the escalation land (HR lead or ops lead?)

Operational asks:
- Laura: can you add legal/HR guardrails to the templates for comp and PIP wording?
- Logan: can your team produce a short one-pager managers can print for their teams?
- Evelyn: any People Ops support for manager training sessions next week?

I'll host a 20-minute sync Wednesday 11:00–11:20 to walk through the matrix. If that's a problem we can move.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com

Attachment: manager-delegation-matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: notice-templates_v1.zip (zip)

On Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 9:15 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> As we close in on the annual feedback cycle I want to lock down two adjacent pieces we keep getting questions about from managers: (1) reviewer delegation ...

Thanks Sergio — good framing. A few quick notes after an initial pass of the matrix: 

- Please add the 'sensitive_roles' flag you mentioned. We should also add a 'compensation_convo_allowed' boolean so we can clearly block delegation for comp-sensitive conversations without an HR rep present.
- We should restrict cross-functional delegation for individual contributor compensation conversations; peer reviewers can be named for behavioral feedback only unless a skip-level sign-off exists.
- For escalation lane, please route initial grievances to the local HR partner (Laura Bennett), with a parallel notice to People Ops (Evelyn) for tracking and audit. If the case involves potential corrective action, route to the Legal+HR team before any formal write-up.

I've updated the matrix with these columns and some sample entries — see manager-delegation-matrix_v2.xlsx attached. I've also lightly redlined the notice templates: please avoid language like 'you will receive a performance action' — stick to factual scheduling and reviewer names.

I'll join the Wed 11:00 sync. If you want, I can bring a short checklist managers must complete before delegating (consent captured, scope of feedback, escalation contact).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
